_doc: Security doctrines (Security.doctrine): how a faction guards a site and answers trouble. A faction names its doctrine in factions.json; anything a doctrine leaves out comes from 'default'. All numbers are HOUSE-RULE until the Night City 2047 pass. budget: the guard roster is crew_size x (base + per_level x security) edgerunners' worth (CPR p399 costs: Mook 1, Lieutenant 2, Mini Boss 3), with officers by security level and at least min_mooks Mooks. outer_patrols: pairs of Mooks out in the open, one pair per area_per_pair squares over area_start, at most max_pairs. alarm: radio_range rouses the caller's side within that many squares, shout_range spreads an alert on a floor. backup: rounds after the call, then tier x (per_level x security + extra) at the far entrance. escalation: who answers if the fight keeps going (responder faction), when (min_security or min_heat), rounds after backup arrives (minus heat/2, at least 2), and maxtac_heat above which MaxTac comes instead. trauma_cards: the mark holds one (mark), officers (Lieutenants and Mini Bosses) at this chance. keycards: guards carry their zone's keycard.
